name: Chimeric Rat
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
otherStatistics: Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A small rat with gills and iridescent scales over its back, rounded ears and a thin bare tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, first printing, p. 246. https://online.anyflip.com/wmdpe/anyb/mobile/index.html#p=247 Base creature from the 2014 Monster Manual, p. 335.
sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on smell.
Chimeric Creation. Its gills allow breathing both air and water. It has iridescent scales.
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a melee weapon attack at +0 against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.
sections.Encounter rules: A creature made by the Chimeric Creator is loyal to whoever pulled its lever. Roll a d6 on the Chimeric Creations table. The machine requires 80 hit points of blood, split evenly across eight containers. Pulling the lever starts the wheel and the creature emerges 1 minute later. The machine recharges after 8 hours. Examining it for at least 1 minute allows a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check to learn its operation. A roll of 5 produces this rat.

name: Giant Walrus
publication: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: An elephant-sized walrus with thick folds of skin, bristly whiskers and two long tusks.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, first printing, p. 312. https://online.anyflip.com/wmdpe/anyb/mobile/index.html#p=313
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The walrus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

Multiattack. Make one Body Flop and one Tusks attack.
Body Flop. Make a melee weapon attack at +8 against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.
Tusks. Make a melee weapon attack at +8 against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 16 (3d6 + 6) piercing damage.
